events.title: Next Real Madrid manager?
events.description:
This market will resolve according to the person who is appointed as the next permanent manager of Real Madrid.

If no permanent manager is appointed by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other." 

Appointments of 'interim,' 'caretaker,' or other non-permanent managers will not impact this market's resolution.

An announcement of a new permanent manager's appointment before this market's close date will immediately resolve this market to the corresponding option, regardless of when the announced appointment goes into effect.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Real Madrid; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

events.title: Copa del Rey Final: Real Madrid vs. Barcelona
events.description:
This market refers to the Copa del Rey Final final between Real Madrid and Barcelona scheduled for April 26, 2025, at 4:00 PM ET.

If Real Madrid wins the match, this market will resolve to “Real Madrid.”

If Barcelona wins the match, this market will resolve to “Barcelona.”

If the match is canceled or delayed beyond May 10, 2025, this market will resolve to 50-50.

This market will resolve based on the entirety of the match, including any extra time and penalties.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the La Liga.

events.title: Florentino Perez out as Real Madrid president by December 31, 2026?

events.title: Next Real Madrid President

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who wins the next Real Madrid Presidential election.
